title: "Introduction"
description: "What ForgeCycle is and how its four roles work together."
sidebar:
  order: 1
---

ForgeCycle is an artifact-driven development loop with four roles, each run by
the model that suits it:

- **Decomposer** assesses a plan too large for one task run and splits it into
  an ordered roadmap of tasks, with the decisions a human must make first.
- **Planner** uses a capable model to investigate the repository and plan one
  task.
- **Builder** uses a faster or cheaper model to implement the plan, test it, and
  commit one coherent turn. It is the only role that changes the repository.
- **Reviewer** uses a capable model to review the work independently and decide
  when the task is done.

Each invocation is fresh. Immutable Markdown handoffs and Git—not vendor session
history—carry context between OpenCode, Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and
Antigravity's `agy` CLI.
